thread:
maria: quick design check from today's review — can we add a tiny inline helper on each eval run row? goal: give a short reason + last-score without clutter, and make it keyboard + screen-reader friendly

jon: yes. show one-line summary on hover/focus and provide a "details" action to open the side panel. tooltip needs to be reachable via :focus-visible.

sophie: copy needs to be short. current mock has multiple bullets. propose: "Last score 81 (\u22125). Open details (Ctrl+.)" — one line only.

kevin: shortcut bikeshed — prefer modifier keys (Ctrl/Meta) to avoid conflicts. we'll catalogue global shortcuts before locking in combos. also lazy-load metric chips only when user opens details to avoid DOM churn.

maria: accessibility checklist for this work: 1) Tooltip available on hover and keyboard focus, 2) aria-describedby on row for screen reader, 3) actions update an aria-live polite region, 4) visible focus outline (not color-only), 5) obey prefers-reduced-motion.

jon: interaction notes: Enter from focused tooltip should move focus into the details panel. Tab should progress out of the row — do not trap. Mobile: replace hover with a tappable info icon that opens the same panel.

sophie: microcopy variants: "Approve/Reject" vs "Mark OK/Mark Problem" — I'll draft 3 options and post for product-review. prefer plain language.

kevin: implementation hint: use `aria-describedby` and set `role=button` on the info affordance. CSS: `.row:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid Highlight; }` and respect reduced-motion. add feature flag and internal a11y pilot.

maria: owners: jon will produce updated mocks + shortcut map, sophie will own copy + QA checklist, kevin will spike lazy-loading + ARIA. I'll file the ticket and assign. tagging @product-review for word checks.

eng-bot: ticket created: PRJ-4902 — "Eval row helper + keyboard flows" (assignee: maria).
